axelis_core.dialog.muestra: Hi! I'm Nilo. I've been fishing this lake for forty years and I know every fish in it. Want me to teach you how to cast?
axelis_core.dialog.genial: That's the spirit! Meet me at the dock.
axelis_core.info.coloso: A crystal guardian that wakes when someone nears its cave. It slams the ground, sweeps its arms and changes phase when hurt.
axelis_core.coloso.fase2_sub: The Colossus hits harder and hurls crystals
axelis_core.coloso.fase3_sub: Ice waves and orbs that hunt you down
npc.axelis_core.mara.hola1: Hi, %s! Fresh bread, cookies, whatever you need. And if you bring wheat, I'll buy it.
npc.axelis_core.mara.hola2: Oh, good to see you. The oven is in a good mood today; looking for something?
npc.axelis_core.mara.hola3: %s! My favorite customer. I saved the best of the morning for you.
npc.axelis_core.mara.hola4: You're like family now. If you ever need anything, this is your home.
npc.axelis_core.iker.hola1: Halt... oh, it's you, %s. The roads aren't safe at night.
npc.axelis_core.iker.hola2: If you're heading out, take arrows. I'll sell you mine at a fair price.
npc.axelis_core.iker.hola3: Good work with those monsters. With you around, I sleep easier.
npc.axelis_core.iker.hola4: Partner, I trust you with my back. Shall we patrol?
mision.axelis_core.pan.desc: I ran out of flour and lots of people are coming today. Could you bring me 6 loaves? I'll pay well.
mision.axelis_core.trigo.desc: I need wheat for the oven every day. Bring me 16 and I'll make it worth your while.
mision.axelis_core.recado.desc: Iker hasn't come for his bread all week. Can you check on him? He's surely at his post.
mision.axelis_core.pastel.desc: Tomorrow is the village party and I want to bake the best cake. I'm missing sugar, eggs and milk.
mision.axelis_core.zombis.desc: Zombies come close to the houses every night. Defeat 5 and the village will sleep in peace.
mision.axelis_core.huesos.desc: Skeletons are shooting at travelers. Take out 4 and bring me 6 bones as proof.
mision.axelis_core.ronda.desc: A guard never rests. Defeat 8 monsters, any kind.
mision.axelis_core.aranas.desc: Spiders are covering the north road with webs. Defeat 4 and bring me 8 string for ropes.
mision.axelis_core.coloso.desc: They say a crystal colossus woke up in a cave. Only someone I fully trust can face it.
axelis_core.mision.llenas: You have too many quests; finish or abandon one
axelis_core.npc.como_amistad: You earn friendship by completing their quests. More friendship unlocks new quests and shop items.
axelis_core.tienda.agotado: Sold out for today; come back tomorrow
axelis_core.tienda.amistad: You need more friendship for that
axelis_core.diario.vacio: No quests in progress. Look for someone with a ! over their head.
axelis_core.diario.vacio_hechas: You haven't finished any quest yet.
